# Fack API Studio

> Fack API Studio is an open-source, self-hosted mock API platform. Design a
> backend schema on a visual node canvas, synthesize realistic responses with
> Faker.js, inject latency and failures, and serve the result from a local mock
> backend — no hosted service required.

## Core capabilities

- Visual flow canvas that compiles to standard JSON Schema
- Faker.js payload synthesis across 20+ generators
- Chaos and latency injection (status codes, delays, custom headers)
- Client-side SQLite storage: schemas, routes, and logs stay local
- One-click export to TypeScript DTOs, Drizzle ORM schemas, and OpenAPI 3.0

## Key pages

- [Home](https://fackapi.studio/): product overview and interactive canvas demo
- [Dashboard](https://fackapi.studio/dashboard): create and manage mock projects

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Karelaking/fack-api): MIT-licensed source
